venue_displayed.what: HyperLiquid leaderboard 'week' window PnL (includes unrealized mark-to-market + funding).
venue_displayed.gdex_relation: gdex.pro's HyperLiquid copy-trade leaderboard re-displays this HL surface; the gdex MCP server (@gemachdao/gdex-mcp-server) was not connected to this session, so the capture was taken from the underlying HL API directly and labeled so.

chain_fills.what: Realized closed PnL (closedPnl - fee) per fill for the address over the trailing-7d window [start,end].

actor_grouping.rule: address->actor grouping is an INPUT to the pure adapter, not computed by it.
actor_grouping.this_capture: Single-address account: the grouping is the identity grouping {address}. wallet-independence multi-address actor clustering is not applicable to one address and was not run; for a multi-address actor the grouping would come from that clustering, recorded here.

dispute_semantics.meaning: A dispute fires when the displayed window bucket differs from the bucket of realized-closed PnL over the same window. It records that the displayed figure is not reproducible from the actor's closed fills (the copier's verification gap) - NOT that any single number was falsified.

selection.how: Scanned the 80 most active (by |week PnL|) leaderboard rows; fetched each address's realized-closed PnL over the trailing-7d window; selected one fully-covered (uncapped) divergence with a small, complete fill set.
selection.aggregate_finding: 18 of 38 scanned active top traders showed a displayed-vs-realized-closed bucket divergence - the verification gap is common, not contrived.
